# Rawhide City Leather

> Firefighter-owned leather shop in Lakeland, Florida, est. 2024. Handmade fire-service gear in full-grain leather: custom radio straps, belts, helmet bands, glove straps, chin straps, leather patch hats, radio buckets, velcro patches and leather conditioner. Everything is hand-cut and hand-stamped, made to order, and sold online only at rawhidecityleather.com. We ship within the United States. We do not cut corners. We cut leather.

## What we make and what it costs (USD)

- Fully custom adjustable radio strap: $165. Holster (radio bucket) and anti-sway strap included. Hand-stamped name, department insignia, your colors, contrast stitching, text outline paint, font choice. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-fully-custom-radio-strap
- Basic adjustable radio strap: $115. Holster and anti-sway strap included. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-basic-radio-strap
- Smokey radio strap: $235, chestnut throughout, one fixed colorway. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-smokey-radio-strap
- Basket weave belt: $85. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-basket-weave-belt
- Heavy duty belt: $50. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-heavy-duty-belt
- Helmet band: $50. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-helmet-band
- Glove strap: $30. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-glove-strap
- Chin strap: $35. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-chin-strap
- Leather patch hat: from $30. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-leather-patch-hat
- Radio bucket (holster): from $40, add $10 for stitching. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-radio-bucket
- 3" leather velcro patch: $7 each, 10% off at ten or more. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-velcro-patch
- Leather butter conditioner: $8. https://rawhidecityleather.com/product-leather-butter
- One-off custom builds: station numbers, badges, memorial pieces. Ask through the contact page.

## Lead times and shipping

- Radio straps: 6 weeks. Everything is made to order, one at a time, by hand.
- Belts, helmet bands, glove straps, chin straps, hats, radio buckets, velcro patches: 1 to 3 weeks.
- Leather butter: ships in 1 to 3 business days.
- Shipping: $10 flat within the US, free on orders of $85 or more.
- Pieces are built from the options chosen at checkout.
- Warranty: any defect in workmanship or materials, we repair it. All sales final. https://rawhidecityleather.com/shipping

## Crew, department and company orders

Matching pieces for a shift, a station, a union local or a business. Patch hats and velcro patches have crew pricing in the cart. Radio straps, belts, helmet bands, glove straps and chin straps in batches are quoted per order. https://rawhidecityleather.com/crews
